purposes.title: Your account and sign-in
purposes.notice: We keep your email address (encrypted), your language and your passkeys so you can sign in, and we send sign-in codes to that address. This is needed to use Convoy: to stop it, delete your account. What we keep after deletion and for how long is listed under Retention.

purposes.title: Test deposits, refunds and the ledger
purposes.notice: When you commit to a pool we record your test deposit, its refund or release and the ledger entries. Tax and company law require us to keep these records: after you delete your account they stay, with your identity replaced by a random code.
purposes.retention: 8 years (Companies Act 2013 s.128(5)); legal review flagged.

purposes.title: Sharing your contact with your dealer
purposes.notice: When you confirm an offer, the dealer of that offer receives your email address so they can arrange the delivery. You can withdraw this at any time: dealers then no longer receive it. A dealer who already received it keeps it under their own obligations.
purposes.retention: Shared only after you confirm; withdrawal stops any further sharing.
